text:
Lina: quick sync — CloudWorks (hw partner) wants a marketplace private offer blending committed spend + hardware co-sell credits. aim: low ops, easy SI quoting, and a predictable renewal path. thoughts?
Omar: lean to invoice-credit for transparency. propose 3 slabs: >$600k, $250k-$599k, <$250k. hw credit applied as onboarding invoice line; renewal bonus separate.
Bea: agree on transparent invoice line. add activation floor $85k ARR and a 90-day clawback prorated. finance prefers invoice-credit but will accept wallet if treated as deferred revenue and surfaced in billing UI.
Rory: ops note: catalog API needs fields: partner_sku, commit_usd, term_months, discount_pct, hw_credit_usd, credit_type (invoice|wallet), credit_expiry_days, activation_floor_usd, clawback_days, partner_restricted_bool. I'll file spec in eng-catalog.
Lina: SI enablement: include a printable SKU + 1-pager co-sell playbook and a fillable email template. partners want clear quoting language.
Omar: renewal incentive: if customer hits >=80% of prior commit at renewal, apply a 4% post-renew invoice credit instead of changing base discount. simpler for billing.
Bea: recommend credit expiry 12 months, clawback prorated over 90 days, and option to net clawback against remaining credits. need SKU mapping for credit posting.
acct-bot: calendar event "CloudWorks private offer kickoff" created for T-21; invites sent to partnerships, finance, legal, eng-catalog, eng-billing, SI leads.
Lina: next steps: Rory to publish API fields, Bea to confirm accounting treatment, Omar to finalise tier math, I'll draft launch cadence and post ADO card by EOD. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
